provider: Microsoft Azure grant for nonprofits ($2,000/yr, renews)

free_tier.stated: $2,000 (USD) in donated Azure services credits per year, renewable. Not a byte quota — a credit grant usable against 'the complete portfolio of Azure products and cloud services', which includes Blob Storage / Data Lake Storage Gen2 / Azure Files.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.stated: per-object-cap: Blob block blob max ~190.7 TiB
per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: no retention statement was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that retention is unlimited
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Azure egress is metered and would eat the credit; this only works as *archive* (rare read) or behind a CDN whose own free tier covers delivery. Archive-tier reads also carry retrieval cost.

tooling: Native Azure API, not S3: rclone backend 'azureblob' (Tier 1, chunked, server-side copy), AzCopy, Azure CLI, BlobFuse for POSIX. Azure does not expose an S3-compatible endpoint on Blob Storage.
chaining: Renews annually at $2,000 ('All Azure Sponsorships renew at $2,000 USD per year'), so it is a recurring grant, not a trial — but the balance is annual, so the multiplier is $2,000 x years x number of verified nonprofit tenants. Renewal must be done manually in the Nonprofit Hub between 30 days before and the expiry date, or usage converts to pay-as-you-go against the stored payment instrument.

limits.value: per-object-cap: Blob block blob max ~190.7 TiB

limits_note: per-object-cap: Blob block blob max ~190.7 TiB, single PUT 5,000 MiB — not the constraint. The constraint is *budget*: the grant is a spend cap, and any per-GB/month rate times 10 TiB must fit inside $2,000/yr. request-rate: standard storage account limits (20,000 IOPS-class). retention: balance expires at the annual renewal date; 'Early consumption of the $2,000 balance does not trigger or permit early renewal'.
